geneListMapping.name: label
geneListMapping.documentation: A human-readable label for this mapping.

geneListMapping.name: mapping_type
geneListMapping.documentation: The kind of correspondence. 'alias': the two rows denote the SAME gene under different identifier systems, a lossless renaming. 'ortholog': the two rows denote DIFFERENT genes in different species inferred to be homologous, a biological inference that can be wrong. Never treat 'ortholog' as 'alias'.

geneListMapping.name: method
geneListMapping.documentation: How the mapping was produced (e.g. 'GEF geneID/geneName pairing', 'OrthoFinder v2.5.5', 'DIAMOND reciprocal best hits').

geneListMapping.name: symmetric
geneListMapping.documentation: 1 if the mapping may be applied in either direction, 0 if it is only valid from list a to list b.

geneListMapping.name: n_pairs
geneListMapping.documentation: The number of data rows in mapping.tsv.

geneListMapping.name: n_genes_mapped_a
geneListMapping.documentation: How many genes of list a appear at least once. Compare against the list's n_genes to see coverage.

geneListMapping.name: n_genes_mapped_b
geneListMapping.documentation: How many genes of list b appear at least once.

geneListMapping.name: has_score
geneListMapping.documentation: 1 if mapping.tsv carries a score column (e.g. an orthology confidence or bit score), 0 otherwise.
